Alex — thanks for reaching out and for the clarity on recipients. We can share a redacted SOC 2 Type II report through a secure, time-limited transfer once an NDA is in place. Two notes on process: 

1) We usually require a mutual NDA signed by both parties before transferring the report. I've attached our standard mutual NDA to speed things up — if you prefer to use your template, please send it and we'll have Legal review.

2) If the report's audit window doesn't fully cover your requested review period, we can provide a bridge letter summarizing the interim controls and whether there were scope changes during the gap. Bridge letters are provided case-by-case and typically take 1-2 business days after the NDA is countersigned.

Next steps from my side: loop in Legal to countersign the NDA or advise on redactions, then prepare an encrypted transfer link and a redacted copy of the Type II. Target turnaround: 48 business hours after countersign.

Attached: Redwood_Mutual_NDA_v1.pdf (please sign & return)
